turret.name: Sentinel
turret.description: Stays still. Fires a rotating beam up to 3 tiles.

patroller.name: Warden
patroller.description: Patrols horizontally. Strikes the four adjacent tiles.

chaser.name: Seeker
chaser.description: Steps toward the nearest explorer. Strikes adjacent tiles.

warden_elite.name: Chrono Warden
warden_elite.description: Telegraphs a wide cross attack. Enrages below half HP, striking all adjacent tiles.
